II. PROBLEM FORMULATION
In this section, we formulate the CSPD as an optimiza-
tion problem which balances the WSR performance and the
smoothness of the effective channels.
A. System Model
We consider a single-cell massive multiple-input multiple-
output (MIMO) system consists of a BS equipped with a
uniform planar array (UPA) comprising M = MzMx an-
tennas, where Mx and Mz denote the number of horizontal
and vertical antennas, respectively. The BS serves K single-
antenna users. Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing
(OFDM) modulation is employed. The number of subcarriers
is Nc, and Nv subcarriers are allocated for data transmission.
Each time slot contains Nb OFDM symbols, and the channel
parameters remain constant within each OFDM symbol but
vary across different symbols. The diagram of the massive
MIMO system is depicted in Fig.1
